articles.name: Why video features are currently unavailable in Brazil
articles.title: Why video features are currently unavailable in Brazil
articles.body:
Last updated: August 17, 2026

If you're in Brazil, Discord’s Go Live and real-time video chat are currently disabled. This is due to a government order, not a bug on our end. 

What this article covers:

  • What’s affected
  • Why this happened
  • When will video features become available

What's affected

Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) ordered Discord to suspend Go Live and video chat features for users in Brazil starting August 17, 2026. That covers all real-time video communication functionality on Discord, including in direct messages (DMs), group direct messages (GDMs), voice channels, and Stage channels. 

Real-time voice communication and messaging is not impacted by this order. You can still talk, chat, and hang out with your friends and communities as usual, you just can't video chat, share your screen, or watch your friend’s Go Live streams for now.

Why this happened

ANPD issued the Order in connection with an investigation related to Brazil's Digital Statute for Children and Adolescents ("Digital ECA"). The Order requires the suspension "of the 'Go Live' feature and of any other functionally equivalent video-transmission and video-sharing features.” Discord disagrees with ANPD’s decision but is committed to cooperating with Brazilian authorities in the implementation of the Digital ECA.

When will video features become available

Unfortunately, we don't have a specific date for you when these features will become available again. We are actively engaged with the ANPD and are seeking a resolution that would restore these video features for our users in Brazil. We'll keep this page updated as we learn more.

If you, your friends, or servers you’re in rely on Go Live or real-time video chat, you can let them know why those features are unavailable and point them to this page.

articles.title: Discord’s Beta Programs FAQ
articles.body:
This article covers information about Discord's Beta Program.

What this article covers:

  • What is Discord's Beta Program?
  • How Beta Eligibility Works
  • How to Check if You Have a Beta feature
  • Active Beta Features
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What is Discord's Beta Program?

Discord’s Beta program is how we test new features to help us improve Discord. A small, random group of users gets access to a beta feature so we can gather feedback and see how it performs in the real world. The feature may move toward a wider release. If it doesn't, it may change significantly or be discontinued.

How Beta Eligibility Works

  • Beta features are given to a small, randomly selected group of users for testing. It's not something you can request or sign up for.
  • Support can't manually add users to a beta or override targeting criteria.
  • Having access to one beta doesn't mean you'll have access to others.
  • Beta access can be removed at any time, including if the experiment ends or the feature doesn't move forward.

How to Check if You Have a Beta feature

If you're one of the users who has access to a beta, you'll see a label indicating that the feature is in beta. For example, you may see a popover in Discord, along with a beta tag next to the feature.

Active Beta Features

  • Favorites: users can favorite certain channels on Discord and keep the conversations that matter most at their fingertips.
  • Bookmarks: users can bookmark the messages they care about most and return to them later.
  • Personal widget: Nitro users can create a personal widget that’s available on their profile. What’s added there is up to you!
  • Scheduled messages: set a time in the future to send your messages in DMs and channels.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why don't I have access to this Beta?

A: Users in a Beta experiment are chosen at random. If you don't have access to the Beta, you're not currently in the experiment group.

Q: How do I get access to a certain Beta feature? Can support add me?

A: There's no way to be manually added to a Beta experiment group. If the Beta goes well and the feature is well received, it may be rolled out more broadly — at which point everyone will have access.

Q: Where can I read more about beta terms?

A: Check out our Paid Services Terms for more information about betas.

articles.name: About Discord Link Previews and the Discordbot
articles.title: About Discord Link Previews and the Discordbot
articles.body:
When you share a link in Discord, you'll often see a small preview card show up with a title, image, or description. This is built using a bot called Discordbot. This article explains how that works, and how website owners can recognize and confirm its traffic.

What this article covers:

  • How Discord Generates Link Previews
  • The Discordbot
    • Identifying Discordbot
    • Verifying Discord Traffic

How Discord Generates Link Previews

When someone shares a link in a Discord message, it automatically visits that link to grab information about the page, like its title, description, and image. This information is used to build the preview card you see in chat.

This only happens when a link is actually shared in a message. There's no continuous scanning or crawling of websites on its own.

If the link points to an image or video, a copy may also be saved for a while so it loads faster next time. When someone views that image or video, it's delivered through Discord's own servers rather than pulled directly from the original website. This keeps the viewer's information, like their IP address, private from the site hosting the file.

The Discordbot

Discordbot is the tool that visits links and builds these previews. If you own a website, you might want to know when it's visiting your site, maybe to show slightly different information, or to make sure your firewall doesn't accidentally block it.

There are two ways to recognize its requests:

  1. Look at the User-Agent (a short bit of text that identifies what's making the request)
  2. Check the IP address the request is coming from

Identifying Discordbot

Every request it makes includes a User-Agent that looks like this:

Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Discordbot/2.0; +https://discordapp.com)

You can check for the word "Discordbot" anywhere in that text. Other parts of it might change over time, so don't rely on matching the whole string exactly.

Important: Just checking the User-Agent isn't enough to be sure a request really came from Discord, since anyone can fake one. If you're using this to decide whether to let a request through your firewall, also check the IP address (see below).

Verifying Discord Traffic

To be sure a request truly came from Discord, check that its IP address is on the official list of public IP ranges. This is published in two formats (json and txt) so you can check it programmatically. It's a good idea to recheck this list every so often, since the ranges can change.

articles.title: Mobile Visual Refresh: What's Changing
articles.body:
Discord's mobile app has a new visual refresh that brings it closer in line with the desktop experience, including updated themes, new shapes, and a decluttered chat bar.

What this article covers:

  • New Themes: Ash and Onyx
  • Updated Device Theme Syncing
  • Nitro Video Call Tile Colors
  • New Shapes: Circles and Squircles
  • Updated Chat Bar
  • Frequently Asked Questions

New Themes: Ash and Onyx

The Ash theme, the original dark theme longtime users know, is back on mobile with improved contrast to meet modern accessibility standards. All four base themes from desktop (Light, Ash, Dark, and Onyx) are now available on mobile.

Onyx, previously known as Midnight on mobile, uses a true black background to match the desktop version. On OLED screens, this can help save battery. You can fine-tune contrast and saturation in your Accessibility settings.

1. Select Settings.

2. Select Appearance.

3. Go to Theme and select your desired theme.

Selecting a theme in Settings > Appearance > Theme

Updated Device Theme Syncing

You can now choose which Light theme and which Dark theme are used when your device switches between Light and Dark mode, instead of being limited to the built-in Light and Dark themes.

1. Select Settings.

2. Select Appearance.

3. Turn on Same as Device Theme.

4. Choose the Light theme and Dark theme you'd like to use with each device mode.

Turning on Same as Device Theme

Note: Turning on Same as Device Theme takes priority over Sync Across Devices. 

Nitro Video Call Tile Colors

Nitro members' voice and video call tiles now match their profile color on both desktop and mobile.

To change your call tile color, select the You tab, select Edit Profile, and update your Profile Theme.

Updating your Profile Theme

New Shapes: Circles and Squircles

Shapes across the mobile app now follow a consistent shape rule: people are circles, and things are squircles (rounded-corner shapes).

  • You, your friends, and bots in your direct messages (DMs) appear as circles.
  • DMs and group DMs stay as circles.
  • Servers and apps appear as squircles, including in your server list.

     

Friends, DMs, and group DMs appear as circles; servers and apps appear as squircles.

Updated Chat Bar

The chat bar has been decluttered to make more room for writing a message. Some actions have moved:

  • Still in the chat bar: Emoji, Gift, Voice Message, and other quick actions.
  • Moved into the + menu: Threads, using an App,
  • New shortcut: long-press the + icon to jump directly to an action without opening the full menu.

Using the + menu and long-press shortcut to create a thread

Tip: If you use Apps or Threads often, try the long-press shortcut to save an extra tap. 

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I still quickly access Threads, Polls, Apps, or file attachments?

A: Yes! Select the + icon to find them, or long-press the + icon to jump straight to your most-used action.

Q: Will my theme change automatically based on my device settings?

A: Only if you turn on Same as Device Theme in your Appearance settings. If it's off, your selected theme stays the same, no matter what mode your device is in.

Q: Does the Onyx/Midnight theme still help save battery?

A: Yes! Onyx (previously called Midnight on mobile) uses a true black background on OLED-compatible devices, which can help save battery.

articles.body:
This article covers eligibility, terms, and current offers for Discord Nitro promotional offers.

What this article covers:

  • Offer Eligibility
  • How to Check if You're Eligible
  • Eligible Subscription Types
  • Offer Terms
  • Available Offers
    • Discord Nitro Free Shop Item
    • Discord Nitro Mobile Orb Drop
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Offer Eligibility

Note: Offers are currently available only on the Discord desktop app and in a web browser, unless otherwise specified.

Discord runs Nitro offers and promotions from time to time. Eligibility depends on a range of factors, including your region, subscription status, and other criteria specific to each offer.

To check if you're eligible for an offer, select the Nitro tab in the Discord desktop app (via the Direct Messages button in the top left, or User Settings > Nitro). If you're eligible, you'll see one or more of the following:

  • A banner or notification in the Nitro tab
  • An in-app message directing you to claim the offer

For most offers, if you don't see one in the Nitro tab, you're not currently eligible, and support isn't able to manually add offers or change eligibility. 

Some promotions, like Game Shop promotions for Nitro subscribers, appear on other surfaces and can have their own eligibility requirements; see that promotion's entry in the Available Offers section below, and the Game Shops FAQ for details.

Note: Eligibility can change while an offer is running. If you qualify today, check back regularly, as offers are tied to real-time criteria and may adjust over time. Similarly, if you don't see an offer right now, you may become eligible later in the offer period.

How to Check if You're Eligible

Follow these steps to see if you currently qualify for a Nitro offer.

1. Update your Discord desktop app to the latest version. Some offers only appear on the latest version.

2. Select the Direct Messages button in the top left, then select the Nitro tab. You can also get here through User Settings > Nitro.

Note: This offer flow is only available on the Discord desktop app and browser.

Nitro Tab

3. Look for a promotional offer box in the Nitro tab, like the example below.

Example of a Nitro offer banner in the Nitro tab

These steps cover offers that appear in the Nitro tab. Some promotions, like Game Shop promotions for Nitro subscribers, appear on other surfaces; for those, check the promotion's entry in the Available Offers section below and the Game Shops FAQ for details.

Eligible Subscription Types

To qualify for any of the offers below, eligible users must purchase Nitro (Monthly or Yearly) and pay through the Nitro tab on Desktop or web. The following subscription types do not qualify to receive the offer, even if you’re eligible:

  • Nitro Credit: purchased in the Shop with Orbs.
  • Nitro Gifts: includes both sending and receiving a Nitro gift.
  • Trials: these offers require an upfront payment, and trials don’t qualify.
  • Referral or Share Nitro Trials: subscriptions started through a referral trial or Share Nitro trial.
  • Nitro Classic or Basic: offers are valid only on paid Nitro standard subscriptions.
  • Upgrades from Classic/Basic > Nitro: only direct subscriptions to Nitro are eligible.
  • Recent subscribers: if you've had an active Nitro subscription within the last 30 days (including trials.)
  • Other Promotions/Discounts: if you subscribe to Nitro via other promotions such as discounts, you’re not eligible for these offers.

Offer Terms

  • Duration: Offers are limited-time and may change or end at any time without notice.
  • Combining offers: Offers can't be combined with other offers unless explicitly stated in that offer's entry below.
  • Account eligibility: Offers are only valid on the Discord account where you’re eligible. Redeeming on a different account or transferring an offer isn’t supported.
  • Regional availability: Availability varies by offer. Some offers aren't available in certain countries or regions; specific restrictions for a live offer are noted in its entry below.
  • Discord's discretion: Discord determines eligibility and reserves the right to limit, modify, or cancel an offer if we detect abuse, fraud, or a violation of our platform terms or policies.
  • Reward terms: Rewards granted through a Nitro offer, like bonus Orbs or Nitro subscription time, are subject to their standard terms and Refund Policy.
  • Refund eligibility: If you've redeemed or received any promotional items from Discord or a Discord partner promotion within 5 days of your Nitro membership renewing or becoming a new subscriber, you won't be eligible for a Nitro refund.
  • Cash value: Offers have no cash value and aren't redeemable for cash.
  • Unmet eligibility: If you don't meet the eligibility criteria for an offer, any associated reward won't be applied to your account, even if you complete the qualifying action (for example, subscribing to Nitro).
  • Redemption deadlines: If a promotional benefit requires you to redeem or activate it rather than being applied automatically, the offer may include a date by which you must do so.

Available Offers

Discord Nitro Free Shop Item

  • Offer type: Unlock a free Shop item with your Nitro subscription purchase
  • Duration: This offer is available for a limited time. Check the Nitro tab (via the Direct Messages button in the top left, or User Settings > Nitro) to see if you’re eligible.
  • What you get: A free Shop item for you to pick from the Shop. Bundles and Collaborations are not included.
  • Terms: Available to a limited number of eligible users. Eligible users see a banner in the Nitro tab on desktop. Requires subscribing to Nitro (Monthly or Yearly) during the offer window. Free Shop item will be added on successful subscription, and you will need to redeem it in the Shop by 9/11. If you don't meet eligibility, the item won’t be applied to your account. Bundles and Collaborations are not included in this promo.

Discord Nitro Mobile Orb Drop

  • Offer type: Get bonus Orbs when you subscribe to Nitro on mobile during the campaign period.
  • Platforms: This offer is only available on the Discord mobile app (iOS and Android).
  • Duration: This offer is available from October 7, 2026 through October 14, 2026 (4PM PT).
  • What you get: A bonus drop of Orbs added to your account after you subscribe to an eligible Nitro subscription.
  • Terms: Requires subscribing to Nitro (Monthly or Yearly) through the Discord mobile app during the offer window. Only new subscribers, meaning you haven't had an active Nitro subscription within the last 30 days, are eligible for the bonus. Once you subscribe, the bonus Orbs are added to your account automatically, with no separate claim step required. You aren't eligible if you already received Orbs from an earlier Nitro Orbs promotion. 

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: I heard about an offer from a friend or on social media, but I don't see it in my app. What's wrong?

A: Nothing's wrong on your end. Offers are based on specific eligibility criteria, so they don't reach everyone at the same time, or at all. To confirm whether you're eligible, check the Nitro tab (via the Direct Messages button in the top left, or User Settings > Nitro).

Q: Why did I stop seeing an offer I saw yesterday?

A: Offers can be time-limited or capped, and eligibility can shift while an offer is running. If the banner's no longer showing up, the offer isn't available to you anymore, and it may have been removed from the Available Offers section above.

Q: Can support add me to an offer or make an exception?

A: Eligibility is determined automatically based on each offer’s eligibility criteria, so support isn't able to add users to an offer or make exceptions.

Q: I'm eligible for an offer. Where do I redeem it?

A: Head to the Nitro tab where you saw the banner and follow the on-screen steps. The Available Offers section above has the offer type and duration for reference, but redemption happens directly in-app.

Q: Does an offer I claim expire?

A: It depends on the offer. Check the duration listed for that offer in the Available Offers section above. Orbs added to your account don't expire.

Q: I think I should be eligible but I'm not seeing the offer. Can you check my account?

A: Individual eligibility decisions come from each offer’s eligibility criteria, so our support team isn't able to review or adjust them on a case-by-case basis.

articles.name: What Protections Do You Get in the Teen Age Group?
articles.title: What Protections Do You Get in the Teen Age Group?
articles.body:
If you have been determined to be in the teen age group (13-17), your account automatically receives certain protections. This article explains what those protections are, what they affect, and what can be changed.

We work to place users into the right age group automatically via our age estimation model, so if you're a teen, these settings may already be in place without you having to do anything.

Note: If you're an adult (18+) and these protections have been applied to your account incorrectly, you can confirm you're an adult to access age-restricted content, spaces, and settings at User Settings > Account Status. Find more detailed instructions here.

What this article covers:

  • What Stays the Same for Teens
  • What are the Teen Safety Protections
    • Content: What You Can and Can't See
    • Social: Who Can Reach You
    • Profile & Activity: What Others Can See
  • If We Haven't Determined Your Age Group Yet
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What Stays the Same for Teens

The core Discord experience, messaging friends, joining voice calls, or servers that are not age-restricted, works the same. Users in the teen age group can still:

  • Message friends and server members you're already connected with
  • Join and participate in servers that aren't age-restricted
  • Make voice and video calls
  • Participate in gaming, communities, study servers, and everything Discord is built for

What are the Teen Safety Protections

Users in the teen age group have a slightly different experience across three areas: what content you can see and can’t see, who can reach you, and what others can see about you. Some of these can only be changed by confirming you're an adult. Others can be adjusted at any time.

Note: Teen safety protections may vary slightly depending on where you live, as some regions have specific requirements under local regulation. For region-specific information, see our directory here.

Content: What You Can and Can’t See

Sensitive content that we flag is filtered automatically. Images and videos flagged by Discord's content filters are blurred or blocked depending on where they appear:

  • Direct messages from friends: blurred
  • Direct messages from strangers: blocked
  • Server channel messages: blurred

Blurred image warning in a channel, showing "May contain sensitive content" with a blurred attachment

Viewing blurred content, or changing these settings to "Show," requires confirming you're an adult.

Sensitive Content Filters settings screen, showing direct messages and server channel media set to Blur or Block

Age-restricted servers and channels are not accessible. Servers and channels marked as age-restricted (18+) are not accessible. Accessing them requires confirming you're an adult.

"Age-Restricted Server" pop-up blocking access, with Confirm Age and Go Back buttons

Age-restricted commands are off. App commands flagged as age-restricted are disabled. Enabling them requires confirming you're an adult.

Messaging Permissions settings showing "Allow access to age-restricted commands from apps in DMs" 

For iOS only: The setting “Allow access to age-restricted servers on iOS” is off. This is a separate, additional step adults must take on iOS to reach age-restricted servers described above. It does not apply to teen accounts, which remain blocked regardless of this setting, and it does not apply on Android. Turning it on requires confirming you're an adult.

Content Filters settings showing “Allow access to age-restricted servers on iOS” off

Social: Who Can Reach You

Message requests are on. All direct messages from people you're not friends with are sent to a separate message requests inbox, so you can review them before they appear in your main DM list. Turning this off requires confirming you're an adult.

Direct Message Permissions settings showing Message Requests toggled on with a note that teen accounts can't turn it off

DM spam filters are set to “filter all”. Spam filtering is applied to all incoming DMs. This can be adjusted at any time.

Friend request alerts are on. You will be alerted before accepting a friend request from an unfamiliar user. Unfamiliar users are those you do not have any mutual friends or shared small servers (< 200 members) with. These alerts can help you make more informed decisions about new connections. These alerts cannot be turned off at this time whether you’re in the adult or teen age group.

"Accept friend request?" alert for a message from an unfamiliar user

Profile & Activity: What Others Can See

Activity sharing is limited. Your activity will only be visible to your friends and members of any small servers (< 200 members) you join, not members of all shared servers. This can be adjusted at any time.

"Where I Share Activity" settings, with "Share in servers with 200 or fewer members" selected

Profile visibility is limited. Your full profile details will only be visible to your friends and members of any small servers (< 200 members) you join, not members of all shared servers. This can be adjusted at any time.

Profile Privacy settings, with "Friends & Small Servers Only" selected

Speaking in Stage channels is not available. Speaking in a Stage channel requires you to confirm you’re an adult, as it can broadcast your voice to large audiences.You can still listen to any Stage channel.

"Confirm you're an adult to speak on stages" prompt shown from a voice channel

If We Haven't Determined Your Age Group Yet

If your account hasn't been placed into an age group yet, your age group status is unconfirmed.

Account Status screen showing an unconfirmed age group with a Confirm Age button

You'll get the same protections as what’s stated above, except for your Profile Privacy and Activity Sharing settings:

  • Unconfirmed users: Profile Privacy and Activity Sharing is open to Friends & All Servers meaning your profile and activity is visible to friends and to members of any server you join, regardless of size. This can be updated at any time.

"Where I Share Activity" settings with "Share in all servers" (Top) & Profile Privacy settings with "Friends & All Servers" selected (Bottom)

If you are unconfirmed, it doesn't affect core Discord features like messaging friends, joining voice calls, or servers that aren't age-restricted.

If you're an adult and want to access age restricted content, spaces, or settings, you can confirm your age group at User Settings > Account Status. See more information here.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: I'm an adult and I've been placed in the teen age group. What do I do? 

A: Head to User Settings > Account Status, pick whichever method you're most comfortable with, and you can confirm your age group, usually in a few minutes. Find more detailed instructions here.

Q: My account hasn't been placed into an age group yet. What does that mean? 

A: It means our  age estimation model doesn't have enough signals yet to determine your age group. Additional protections apply in the meantime. Otherwise, the core Discord experience, messaging friends, joining voice calls, or servers that are not age-restricted, works the same.

If you're an adult and want access to age-restricted content, spaces, or settings, you can confirm you’re an adult at User Settings > Account Status. Find more detailed instructions here.

Q: Why do these protections apply to my account? 

A: You’ve been determined to be in the teen age group. If you're an adult and think we got it wrong, you can confirm your age group. Find more detailed instructions here.

Q: Can I turn these protections off? 

A: Some settings can only be changed after confirming you're an adult. Others, like activity sharing and profile visibility, can be adjusted at any time. See the sections above for details on which protections can be turned off.

Q: Can other people see that I'm in the teen age group? 

A: Your age group isn't shown on your profile or visible to other members in a server.

Q: Do these protections apply in the UK, Australia, and Brazil? 

A: Teen safety protections may vary slightly depending on where you live, as some regions have specific requirements under local regulation. For region-specific information, see our directory here.

Q: Will these protections change over time? 

A: We continue to adjust our approach as regulations evolve. We'll communicate any changes that affect your experience.

Q: I'm a parent, can I manage my teen's settings? 

A: Teen safety protections are applied when we believe a user is a teen and most can't be changed by anyone other than your teen confirming they're an adult. A few settings, like Sensitive Content Filters and Message Requests, can be managed by you if you're connected through Family Center, though you'll need to be in the adult age group yourself to update Message Requests. For the full list of what you can manage and how to connect, read our help center article on Family Center.

articles.name: [Known Issue] Small Videos Won't Play in the Desktop App
articles.title: [Known Issue] Small Videos Won't Play in the Desktop App
articles.body:
Some videos with very small dimensions won't play directly in the Discord desktop app, even though the file itself is valid and plays normally elsewhere. Here's why this happens, and how to watch the video in the meantime.

What this article covers:

  • Why This Happens
  • What You Can Do
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Why This Happens

The Discord desktop app uses hardware-only video decoding to play videos efficiently. Due to varying hardware decoder compatibility requirements, playing back videos less than 64 pixels on any edge is not supported.

When a video falls below that threshold, playback can't start on desktop, even though the file itself isn't damaged or corrupted.

What You Can Do

If a video won't play in the desktop app, you can still watch it using your device's default media player:

  1. Download the video file from Discord.
  2. Open the downloaded file with your device's default media player (ie. QuickTime Player, Windows Media Player, or VLC).
  3. The video should play outside of Discord.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why won't my video play directly in Discord?

A: Due to varying hardware decoder compatibility requirements, videos less than 64 pixels on any edge aren't supported for playback. This isn't an issue with your file - it's a limitation of the hardware decoder.

Q: Is my video file corrupted?

A: No. The file is valid and plays normally in other media players. This limitation only affects direct playback within the Discord desktop app.

articles.name: How to Use the LFG Channels  to Find Game Sessions on Discord
articles.title: How to Use the LFG Channels  to Find Game Sessions on Discord
articles.body:
LFG Channels are a channel type that give players in select servers a dedicated space to post and browse live game invites, so it's easier to find others to play with.

What this article covers:

  • What is the LFG Channel?
  • Eligibility
  • How to Make an LFG Post 
  • How to Join an LFG Post
  • Linking Your Account
  • Frequently Asked Questions
Important: LFG Channels are currently an experiment and not widely available. It's only enabled in a small number of servers at this time.

What is an LFG Channel?

LFG Channels are a forum-style channel where players in eligible servers can post and browse live game invites for select supported games. Instead of sending invites directly to friends where they can get buried in chat, you can post your session to the channel so other players in the server can find and join it.

Each LFG Channel post includes its own thread, so players can chat and connect to voice together before joining.

Eligibility

 LFG Channels are currently being tested with a limited group of servers and players.

  • It's currently available in the official ARC Raiders server. Support for other games is coming soon.
  • It's available to members of those servers who have the corresponding game installed.
Note: Want other players to be able to join you? Set your privacy or activity-sharing settings to public on the platform you play on (e.g. Steam, Epic, Xbox, and etc.).

How to Make an LFG Post

Note: For other players to join you directly, Discord needs to be able to see and share your game activity. That means keeping your game running, and turning on activity sharing in two places:
1. User Settings > Activity Privacy > What Activity I Share, turn on Share my activity. 
2. Right-click the ARC Raiders server icon, select Privacy Settings, and turn on Share my activity for that server.

You can post your own game session to the LFG Channel so other players can find and join you.

1. Select Create Post in the top-right corner of the LFG channel.

  

Example of arc-raiders-lfg Channel (Top) & Create Post Button (Bottom)

2. Add a description, select relevant tags, and add or remove voice chat. To include an invite embed so others can join you directly from Discord, select Link Account and have your game open. The embed only appears while you're playing.

Tip: Want other players to join your game directly? Link your account so your post shows a live session card that lets other players see your squad's open spots and request to join your lobby. If you decide to stay unlinked, you can still create posts and join other players' games without it. 

Invite Creation Window

3. Select Create to publish your post. It'll appear in the channel for other players to browse. 

Example of Post with Account Linked

How to Join an LFG Invite

You can join another player's posted invite directly from the LFG Channel.

1. Browse the LFG Channel to find a session you'd like to join.

2. Open the post and select Join.

Depending on the game, this either sends a request that the post creator accepts in-game, or joins you directly if the session is open to anyone.

Tip: Chat in the thread before joining to confirm details like play style, mic preference, and what the poster is looking for.

Linking Your Discord Account

Linking your account connects your Discord account to your in-game account for a supported game.

Linking your account is optional, but it's the easiest way to show your squad's open spots and get others to join your game seamlessly. Once linked, your post shows a live invite embed so other players can join you directly from Discord. Without it, you can still create posts and join other players' games. 

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why don't I see the LFG Channel in my server?

A: This feature is part of a limited experiment and is only visible in select servers for supported games. If you don't see it, your server may not currently be part of the experiment.

Q: Can I request access to the LFG Channel experiment?

A: This experiment is currently limited to a small group of servers, and access can't be requested or manually granted at this time.

Q: Do I need to link my account to use the LFG Channel?

A: No, linking is optional. If you link your account, your post will show a live session card so other players can join you directly. 

If you stay unlinked, you can still create posts and join other players' games, you just won't have that live session card.

Q: Why am I unable to accept a game invite? 

A: This can happen if you're trying to join from a different platform than where the game is installed. 

Make sure you're using the same platform where the game is installed (e.g. Steam, Epic, Xbox, and etc.) to create or join an LFG post. 

Q: Why don't I see a live invite embed on my post?

A: A live invite embed only shows when all of the following are true: your account is linked, your game is running, and your privacy or activity-sharing settings are set to public on the platform you play on (e.g. Steam, Epic, Xbox, and etc.), and you've turned on activity sharing both in your Discord User Settings and for the official ARC Raiders server. 

Make sure your account is linked and your game is already running before you create your post. The embed won't appear if you complete these steps afterward.

articles.name: Discord on Meta Quest FAQ
articles.title: Discord on Meta Quest FAQ
articles.body:
Discord is available to download directly from the Meta Horizon Store — bringing the full Discord experience to your Meta Quest headset.

What this article covers:

  • Is Discord Available on Meta Quest?
  • How to Download Discord on Meta Quest
  • What Discord Features Are Available on Meta Quest?
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Is Discord Available on Meta Quest?

If you’re a Meta Quest user, you can use Discord while in your VR experience. Through Meta Quest, you can access the full Discord app, like your servers, direct messages (DMs),  group DMs, voice/video calls, without needing a separate device or using the VR headset web browser.

You can get Discord on your Meta Quest by downloading the app through the Meta Horizon Store.

A Discord server as seen in the Discord app on a Meta Quest device.

How to Download Discord on Meta Quest

Discord is available to download from the Meta Horizon Store. You can find it directly from your headset or through the Meta website.

1. Open the Meta Horizon Store on your Meta Quest headset, or visit the Meta Horizon Store page on your web browser.

2. Select Install (or Get) to install Discord on your headset.

3. Once installed, open the Discord app and log in to your existing Discord account, or create a new account if you don't have one yet.

The Discord app on the Meta Horizon Store for installation.

Note: Note: If you’re having issues with the Meta Horizon store or downloading the Discord app to your Meta Quest, please reach out to Meta Support.

What Discord Features Are Available on Meta Quest?

Discord on Meta Quest includes all the features you're used to from the Discord app, including:

  • Your servers, DMs, and Group DMs
  • Voice calls using your headset's built-in microphone
  • Video calls if you’ve set up a Meta Avatar
  • Streaming Meta Quest gameplay to your friend on Discord

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do I need a new Discord account to use Discord on Meta Quest?

A: No. You can log in with your existing Discord account. If you don't have one yet, you can create a new account directly from the app on your headset.

Q: Is Discord on Meta Quest free to download?

A: Yes. Discord is free to download from the Meta Horizon Store. Some features require a Discord Nitro subscription.

Q: Where can I download Discord for my Meta Quest headset?

A: You can find the Discord app in the Meta Horizon Store on your headset or on your browser. 

Q: What Meta Quest devices is Discord available on?

A: Discord is available to use on the following Meta Quest devices: Quest 2, Quest Pro, and Quest 3 series.

Q: Can I use Discord voice and video calls while in VR?

A: Yes. Because Meta Quest headsets have a built-in microphone, you can join Discord voice and video calls directly from your headset without needing a separate device. You can also use your Meta Avatar in video calls if you’ve created one.

Q: I’m having issues with my Discord app on my Meta Quest device.

A: If you’re having issues with the Discord app itself, please reach out to our Support team. If you’re having issues with your Meta Quest device, please reach out to Meta Support.

Q: Does Meta see my activity in Discord because I use the app on Meta Quest?

A: No. Using the Discord app on Meta Quest is like using Discord on any other supported device.

Q: How does Discord use my data when I use the Discord app on Meta Quest?

A: Discord uses your data consistent with our Privacy Policy, like on any other device.

2. Select the Discord offer tile. If you're not yet logged in or verified, you'll be prompted to do so before continuing.

Discord Offer Tile on UNiDAYS Webpage (top) & Mobile App (bottom)

How to Claim Your Nitro from UNiDAYS

1. Once you're logged in and verified on UNiDAYS, select the Discord offer on the Discord partner page.

2. Select Activate discount. You'll be redirected to Discord with the discount automatically applied, no promo code is required.

Activate discount Button

3. From there, follow the on-screen instructions to complete the redemption process on your Discord account.

How do I redeem the Nitro Trial on my Discord Account?

Once you have claimed the promo, you'll now need to officially redeem this promo on your Discord account. You must redeem this Nitro trial by August 8, 2027 (11:59PM PT).

Eligibility for Redeeming the Nitro Trial

Note: This promotion is not eligible in the following regions: Syria, Russia, Turkey, Iran, North Korea, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Donetsk, and Luhansk.  If you receive an "Unknown Gift Code" error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Users who have had an active Nitro subscription or Nitro trial in the last 12 months are not eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Users who have had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on their accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If a user has had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on their account and they’ve never had a Nitro subscription, redeeming this promotion will override that subscription.

Users who have already claimed a gift from this promotion are not eligible to claim further gifts from this promotion.

Step by Step Redeem Instructions

If you're eligible and ready to redeem this Nitro subscription on your own Discord account, you can follow these steps below to redeem the promo.

Note:
- Before redeeming Nitro, make sure you are logged in your own Discord account.
- If you accidentally redeemed the Nitro promo on an account that is not yours, we are unable to provide you with another promo.

Step 1 - Pressing the Promo Link/Copying and Pasting into your Browser Window

  • Start by directly pressing the promotion link or copying and pasting the promotion link into your browser window.
Note: If you're redeeming this Nitro promo link in the Discord Gift Inventory, enter only your unique 24-digit code from the Nitro promotion link in the following format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX

Step 2 - Logging into Discord

  •  If you're not already logged into Discord in your browser, you will then be automatically redirected to either:

Create an account Page (Left) and Login page (Right)

Step 3 - Confirming the Correct Account and Payment Method

  • Once you have logged into your Discord account, you'll see a new message asking you to confirm that you are accepting the Nitro subscription on the correct Discord account.
    • You'll see a notice saying: "You are accepting this gift as _________" 
  • If your Discord account does not have your payment information, you'll be asked to fill out your payment details. (Note: You will not be charged until the free trial ends and the subscription renews)
  • When you've filled out all the necessary information and you're ready to redeem this promotion, press the "Accept Gift" button. 
Note: If you're logged into the incorrect Discord account, press the "Wrong account" button to login to the other account.

Step 4 - Subscription Now Activated

  • After accepting the promo to your account, you'll now be automatically redirected to your Subscriptions tab in your User Settings to see your newly activated Nitro subscription on your account.

What if I am an Active Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting Subscriber? 

Just to clarify - if you have had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on your account and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

So long as you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro subscription, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro subscription.

Important: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current subscriptions, and **you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current subscription**.

At the end of the promotion period, you'll be converted to a paying Nitro subscription per month unless you cancel your subscription.

How do I share my Code with a Friend?

If you're unable to redeem the Nitro subscription link, you can share this link with a friend to use instead.

After you press on and open the promotion link, you can directly copy the promotion URL link in the new page and send it to a friend. We recommend sending the link in a private direct message. Make sure your friend redeems the code by August 8, 2027 (11:59PM PT).

Frequently Asked Questions

We know there's a lot of information to unpack on this promotion above, so we've also broken down this information in this FAQ section as well too.

  • Promotion Details
  • Eligibility for the Promotion
  • Payment Info and Subscription Questions
  • Potential Errors and Other Issues
    • Already Had/Have Nitro
    • Already Redeemed
    • Something's Wrong Here

Promotion Details

Q: How long does this promotion run for?

A: UNiDAYS users can claim Discord Nitro promo between July 9, 2026 (10:00AM PT to July 9, 2027 (11:59PM PT),

After July 9, 2027 (11:59PM PT), UNiDAYS users will no longer be able to claim a trial promo.

Q: How long does the Discord Nitro promotion last for?

A: You must redeem the Nitro promotion by August 8, 2027 (11:59PM PT).

If a code has not been redeemed to the Discord account by August 8, 2027 (11:59PM PT) it will expire and you will no longer be able to have 1 month of Discord Nitro.

Eligibility for the Promotion

Q: Who can claim this promotion?

A: To claim this promotion, you must be a verified student or recent graduate with an active UNiDAYS account. 

Q: Who can redeem this Nitro trial to their Discord account?

A: Users who have never had an active Nitro subscription on their Discord accounts are eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Additionally, users who previously had a Discord Nitro subscription and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months are ineligible.

This promotion is not eligible in the following regions: Syria, Russia, Turkey, Iran, North Korea, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Donetsk, and Luhansk. If you receive an "Unknown Gift Code" error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Q: What if I'm a current or previous Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or a Server Boost subscription? Can I also take part in this promotion? 

A: If you previously had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on your accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro subscription,  you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro subscription.

Important: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current subscriptions, and **you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current subscription**.

At the end of the promotion period, you'll be converted to a paying Nitro subscription per month unless you cancel your subscription.

Payment Info and Subscription Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?

A: Because Nitro is a subscription plan, at the end of your 1 month trial, we will start your first billing cycle so you can continue to enjoy Nitro on Discord.

However, you can cancel the Nitro subscription at any time before the end of the 1 month.

Q: Why do I see a temporary hold/charge on my account when this is supposed to be a free promotion?

A: Just to clarify, this Nitro promotion is free, however, there will be a temporary hold placed on the payment method upon activating the promotion. This is to help Discord confirm the payment method works as expected and to prevent the use of fraudulent payment methods. This charge will appear in your Discord transaction history, and it may appear as a hold on your payment method.

We immediately reverse the temporary hold, and you’ll see that reflected in your Discord transaction history. Your bank may take longer to remove the hold from your payment method.

Note: Banks will usually remove the temporary hold from your account within a few business days.

If your Discord transaction history does not show the hold released after 5 business days, please let us know at https://dis.gd/contact, and our support team will be able to investigate this issue further.

Potential Errors and Other Issues

Q: What if I can't find or access the Discord offer on UNiDAYS?

A: All verified and eligible students with an active UNiDAYS account will have direct access to the Discord offer on the UNiDAYS platform.

If you believe you are eligible but are unable to access the offer, make sure you are logged into your UNiDAYS account and that your student status has been verified.

If you're still having trouble, contact UNiDAYS's support team: https://www.myunidays.com/support  

Q: I see a Sad Trombone error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo link.

A: Would you happen to be entering this Nitro promo link from the promotion into the Discord Gift Inventory or as a link within Discord chat?

If so, this is the incorrect method for redeeming the Nitro promo link, and you will see an error when attempting to redeem the promotion.

In order to successfully claim this promotion, enter only your unique 24-digit code from the Nitro promotion link in the following format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

Q: I see a "Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already" error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you're seeing an "Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already" error, that means that the Discord account you're trying to redeem this promotion on currently has a Nitro subscription so it is ineligible for this Nitro promotion.

Please make sure you're logged into the account that you want to redeem this promotion on. Or you can give the promotion link to a friend who hasn't had Nitro before.

Q: I see a "Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub!" error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you're seeing an “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub” error, that means that you've previously subscribed to Nitro on your Discord account and you won't be able to redeem this 1 month perk.

If you have never subscribed to Nitro, please submit a ticket through our support system: https://dis.gd/contact and our support team will be able to investigate further.

Be sure to include your full Discord ID and email address tied to your Discord account.

Q: I see a "Looks like this gift has already been claimed" error when I try to claim my Nitro promo.

A: If you are seeing a "Looks like this gift has already been claimed" error, that means that the Nitro promo has already been used and cannot be used again. You may need to double check if you've claimed this promo on another Discord account.

In particular, if you redeem this promo link using your mobile device, double check the browser on your mobile device and see which Discord account you are currently logged into.

Unfortunately, once the promo link has been redeemed, the promo link cannot be re-enabled, and the Nitro cannot be transferred from one account to another.

Q: I see a "Wait a Second...Looks like this code didn't work." error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you're seeing an “Wait a Second...Looks like this code didn't work.” error, that means that the link is invalid. If you've copy and pasted this link, we recommend you double check the link you were given once more and make sure it exactly matches the link sent to your email.

If you received this link from a friend, double check with your friend on the exact link to make sure that it matches the link in their email.

Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if your friend has given an invalid link and we will not be able to provide a new link.

Q: I see a "Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption" error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you're seeing a "Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption" error, that means that the payment method you've selected to cover the temporary $1 hold cannot be used for that purpose. 

Please keep in mind that prepaid payment methods, such as Gcash, cannot be used to cover temporary holds due to the nature of how prepaid payment methods function.

For more information on temporary holds, please check out this article!

Q: I see a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error, that means the maximum limit for claims of this promotion has been reached and this promotion can no longer be claimed. If you have claimed this Nitro promotion, you are still able to redeem it to your Discord account!

Please note that the support team is unable to assist you if you run into this error and we are not able to increase the limit of claims.

Q: I see a “Looks like your email isn’t verified. Make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift.”

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like your email isn’t verified, make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift” error, you are trying to redeem this Nitro promotion on a Discord account with an email that hasn’t been verified yet.

You can check out this support article on how to resend the email verification for your Discord account. If you need help setting up your Discord account, you can read our Getting Started article. 

Q: I’m having trouble with my UNiDAYS account.

A: Reach out to UNiDAYS’s support team: https://www.myunidays.com/support

articles.body:
Discord gift cards are an easy way to treat yourself or a friend. Redeem one to add balance to your account and spend it on Nitro, Shop items, Server Boosts, and more. 

What this article covers:

  • What are Discord gift cards?
  • Where can I buy a Discord gift card?
  • What can I buy with a Discord gift card?
  • How to Redeem Your Gift Card

Important: Discord gift cards are currently available at select online retailers in the United States. We'll be expanding availability over time, so check back for updates.

What are Discord gift cards?

Discord gift cards are a prepaid card you can use to make purchases on Discord. Once redeemed, the balance is added directly to your account and can be spent across items in Discord.

Gift cards are a great option if you:

  • Don't have a credit card or prefer not to link one to your account
  • Want a flexible way to pay for Nitro, Shop items, or other Discord purchases
  • Want to set a budget and add a specific amount to your account before spending
  • Are a parent or friend who wants to give the gift of Discord to someone in your life 

Where can I buy a Discord gift card?

Discord gift cards are available at select online retailers in the United States. You can find more information on where to buy here.

What can I buy with a Discord gift card?

Once redeemed, you can spend your gift card balance on things like: 

  • Nitro and Nitro Basic - Discord's premium subscription plans.
  • Nitro Gifts - Buying Nitro for your friends.
  • The Discord Shop - Avatar Decorations, Profile Effects, Nameplates, and more. 
  • Server Boosts - Support your favorite servers and help unlock perks for the whole community.
  • Game Shops - Purchase in-game items for select titles directly through Discord.

Discord Gift Card Balance

How to Redeem Your Gift Card

You can redeem your gift card in two ways: through the discord.com/redeem web page, or directly in the desktop app via Billing.

Important: Make sure you're logged into the correct account before redeeming. Gift card balances cannot be transferred between accounts once redeemed.

Desktop App

1. Open the Discord desktop app and select the cogwheel [] next to your username to open User Settings.

2. Head to User Settings > Billing > Payment Methods, and select the Redeem button by the Gift Card Balance option.

3. Enter your gift card code exactly as shown and follow the on-screen prompts. 

4. Press Redeem. Your balance will be added to your account immediately.

Redeeming a Discord Gift Card through Billing on Desktop

Discord.com/redeem

1. Head to discord.com/redeem. You can do this on any mobile, desktop, or tablet device.

2. Log in to your Discord account, or create one if you're new.

3. Enter your gift card code exactly as provided and follow the on-screen prompts.

4. Press Redeem. Your updated balance will appear on screen.

5. Select Get Nitro or Get Nitro Basic to start spending your balance, or head to the desktop app to explore more options in the Shop.

Discord.com/redeem Landing Page

Mobile Availability

Redeeming a gift card and spending your balance aren’t available in the mobile app at this time.

You can still redeem a gift card and purchase items using a browser on your mobile phone:

  • Redeem your gift card at discord.com/redeem. 
  • After redeeming, open Discord in your browser at discord.com/login to spend on things like Nitro, the Shop, and more. 
  • Your purchases will be available across devices on your account.
  • You can view your balance in the web app as well.

  

Redeeming a Discord Gift Card through Mobile Web Browser

Frequently Asked Questions

This FAQ is divided into sections:

  • Buying Gift Cards
  • Redeeming
  • Your Balance & Spending
  • Account & Policies
  • Other

Buying Gift Cards

Q: Are digital and physical gift cards available? 

A: Digital gift cards are available in the US at select retailers. Physical cards are coming soon, check out our Help Center for the latest on where to buy.

Q: What countries are Discord gift cards available in?

A: Digital gift cards are only available in the US, and we have more cooking…stay tuned!

Q: Where can I buy Discord gift cards?

A: Digital gift cards are available in the US at select retailers. Physical cards are coming soon, check out our Help Center for the latest on where to buy.

Q: What gift card amounts are available?

A: Discord gift cards are available in $25 and $50 options, or a choose your adventure option where you can pick between $15–$150. Availability may vary by retailer.

Q: Can I buy a gift card for someone in another country?

A: Gift cards can only be redeemed in the country they were purchased in. To redeem, your account's Country/Region setting must match the gift card's currency.

Redeeming

Q: Do I need an account to redeem my gift card?

A: Yep! You must be logged into a Discord account to redeem a gift card. Don’t have one yet? It’s free to sign up at Discord.com.

Q: Can I redeem a gift card from another country?

A: Gift cards can only be redeemed in the country they were purchased in. To redeem, your account's Country/Region setting must match the gift card's currency.

Q: Why isn't my gift card code working?

A: Let’s help with that! Here are some pro tips and considerations:

  • Typo? Make sure you're entering the code exactly as shown on the back of the card.
  • Wrong Country? Gift cards can only be redeemed in the country they were purchased in. If your Country/Region doesn't match the card's currency, redemption will be blocked. You can see what region your account is set to under Country/Region in User Settings > Billing > Payment Methods.
  • Balance or redemption limit reached. Your account may have reached its wallet balance or redemption limit.
  • Platform pro tip. Just a heads up, you can only view and spend your balance on the desktop app or web browser.

If none of the above apply and your code still isn't working, please contact Discord support with your card details and a photo of the back of the card.

Q: I’m still having issues with my Discord gift card. What do I do? 

A: If you're still experiencing issues with your gift card, you can submit a request through the Discord support form. 

Visit dis.gd/billing and select Refunds, Cancellations & Payments. From there, choose Gift Cards under the Type of Billing Issue and complete the rest of the form based on your specific concern.

Your Balance & Spending

Q: Where can I see my gift card balance?

A:  You can check your balance anytime under User Settings > Billing > Payment Methods within the desktop app or web browser.

Q: Does my gift card or balance expire?
A: Discord gift cards and balances in the United States do not expire. Expiration terms vary by country in other regions. See our Gift Card Terms and Wallet Terms for more information.

Q: Can I redeem multiple gift cards?

A: Yes! You can redeem multiple gift cards to your Discord account, each one will add to your existing gift card balance up to the maximum balance limit in your country.

Q: Is there a limit for how much money I can have in my account?

A: Yes, there is a limit! If you have multi-factor authentication on your account, you can have a higher balance. 

Don’t have MFA set up? You should! Check out how to set up MFA here.

Q: Can I use my gift card balance on mobile?

A: You can view and use your gift card balance on desktop app and web browser. Anything you buy will show up across all your devices.

Q: Are there any cases where I cannot use my gift card balance?

A: Yes. Your gift card balance may be temporarily unavailable if your wallet has been frozen, or if you have reached your gift card balance limit. If you believe this is an error, please contact Discord support.

Q: Is there anything I can’t buy with a Discord gift card?

A: You can spend your Discord gift card balance on most purchasable things in Discord - like Nitro, the Shop, Server Boosts, Gifts on Discord, and more. The option to use your balance won’t show up during check-out if you can’t use a gift card balance to purchase that item.

Q: Where can I see my gift card balance?

You can check your balance anytime in the desktop or web app under User Settings > Billing.

Q: Can I use my gift card balance and another payment method together in one purchase?

A: Your gift card balance must cover the cost of your purchase to use. Otherwise, you’ll need to use another payment method on file for purchase at this time. We don't currently support splitting a payment between your gift card balance and another payment method, but we're working on it! 

Q: What happens if my subscription renews and my gift card balance is too low?

A: If your Gift Card balance is insufficient at renewal, you’ll have 3 days to update your payment method before it expires. Discord won't automatically charge another payment method, so make sure your balance is topped up before your renewal date. You can update your payment method anytime in User Settings > Billing Settings > Subscriptions.

Account & Policies 

Q: Can I transfer my gift card balance to another account?

A: No. Gift card balances are tied to the account they were redeemed on and cannot be transferred.

Q: What happens to my gift card balance if I delete my account?

A: If you delete your Discord account, any remaining gift card balance may be forfeited and cannot be recovered. More information can be found in the Wallet Terms. 

Q: What happens if my Discord account is suspended or terminated?

A: Use of Discord is subject to our Terms of Service, Community Guidelines, and other policies. Violating these terms may result in action on your account, including suspension or termination. If your account is suspended, you will not have access to your gift card balance for the duration of the suspension. See our Gift Card Terms and Wallet Terms for more information.

Q: What should I do if I think my gift card was stolen or used fraudulently?

A: Discord can assist with suspicious activity on your account, such as an unknown charge using your gift card balance. You’ll need to work with the retailer for any issues with your gift card prior to redemption.

If you suspect a fraudulent purchase was made using your Discord gift card balance, you can reach out to our support team here. Please fill out the ticket with the following categories:

  • What can we help you with?: Refunds, Cancellations & Payments
  • Type of Billing Issue?: I have a question/issue regarding an unauthorized transaction

Q: Can I get a refund for a purchase made with a Discord gift card?

A: If a purchase made with your gift card balance qualifies for a refund under Discord's standard refund policy, the refund will be returned to your account balance, not to another payment method.

Other

Q: Who is CIMI / Weary Travelers Inc.?

CIMI is the company we work with to bring gift cards to you. Weary Travelers, Inc. is the issuer of our gift cards. Someone at Discord (shhh, it was Byron) thought that Weary Travelers was a fun name - so rest here weary traveler. You have seen too many FAQs. Sit by the fire before you continue. When you’re ready, you can find more information in the Gift Card Terms and Wallet Terms.
